security_scope: Ordinary company stocks only; four digits, exclude 0xxx/91xx. Existing official company universe; no ETF/TDR/foreign second listing.

fields.trade.v: Last actual transaction volume (official fallback into tv/s)
fields.tv: Transaction volume shown by regular trading table
fields.v: Accumulated trading volume shown by regular trading table
fields.s: Detailed display volume; not relied upon independently

evidence_notes: TWSE and TPEx regular quote tables map TRADE_VOLUME to tv and ACC_TRADE_VOLUME_N to v.
Official frontend fallback takes trade.v and supplies missing tv and s after choosing nested actual trade.z/t.
Official UI labels regular quotations in trading units and notes normal stock trading units are 1000 shares.
Official MIS scope note excludes odd-lot, block, off-hour, auction and tender trades.
limitations: Semantic/unit contract confirmed; per-stock volume must separately pass fresh two-observation agreement and cumulative-delta checks. Official daily total has a different scope and does not independently validate these volumes.
